title: Uruguay's top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Uruguay in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the 2026 World Cup final. Only goals from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Dario Silva: Dario Silva is just outside with 8 from 2000 on.
notes.Diego Godin: Diego Godin is just outside with 8.
notes.Cristhian Stuani: Cristhian Stuani is just outside with 8.
notes.Jose Maria Gimenez: Jose Maria Gimenez is just outside with 8.
notes.Alvaro Recoba: Alvaro Recoba scored 4 of his 11 from 2000 on.

checks: Counted match by match: every Transfermarkt match report for the nation from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026 (starters plus substitutes who came on; scorers, own goals left out; results checked against each match's score, shoot-outs aside), then checked year by year against National Football Teams (its per-year player tables, FIFA and non-FIFA columns added together, September and October 2026 games taken off). Career totals also checked against RSSSF's record players page and Wikipedia (player infoboxes and caps-by-year tables), with games after 19 July 2026 taken off. Transfermarkt lacks line-ups or scorers for four Uruguay games (China and Bosnia in early 2000 and 2001, Tunisia in 2006, Venezuela in 2007); National Football Teams has them, and its totals match Transfermarkt's for everyone near the ten. Abreu's 23 (26 in all, 3 before 2000) checked against his Wikipedia caps-by-year table. Darwin Nunez and De Arrascaeta exclude their goals in September 2026. Lugano and Valverde tie on 9 for 10th, so they share it as a pool.
